title: Repair-or-Replace and Cash-in-Lieu Figures, Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
The figures Bridgewell applies under the Real Estate Service Contracts plans when choosing between repair and replacement, and when settling a replacement in cash, are the same on all six plans.

| Figure | Bridgewell Closing Starter | Bridgewell Closing Standard | Bridgewell Closing Plus | Bridgewell Closing Premier | Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair-to-replace threshold (repair estimate as a share of contracted replacement cost) | 60% | 60% | 60% | 60% | 60% | 60% |
| Parts lead time beyond which Bridgewell replaces (calendar days) | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Cash-in-lieu offer validity (calendar days after the offer) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Cash-in-lieu payment period (calendar days after acceptance) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## What each figure is

- **Repair-to-replace threshold**: the repair estimate, as a fraction (0.6) of the contracted replacement cost, at or above which Bridgewell replaces.
- **Parts lead time**: the calendar days of parts lead time beyond which Bridgewell replaces instead of waiting.
- **Offer validity**: the calendar days after a cash-in-lieu offer within which it may be accepted.
- **Payment period**: the calendar days after acceptance within which cash in lieu is paid.

## Illustration (hypothetical item)

For a hypothetical item whose contracted replacement cost is $2000.00, 60% of that cost is $1200.00: a repair estimate of $1200.00 is at the threshold, and an estimate of $1199.99 is below it.
